description: The Regal Year 2026–27 commenced on a memorable and symbolic note with “Stroke of Midnight,” an exclusive District 3141 programme for incoming Club Presidents. Beginning on the evening of 30 June and culminating at the stroke of midnight on 1 July 2026, Presidents-Elect of Rotary District 3141 were formally sworn in and installed as Club Presidents by their respective Assistant Governors. The ceremony marked the official transition into the new Rotary Year and the beginning of the Regal leadership journey. Rtn. Dr. Vinod Nair was formally installed as President of the Rotary Club of Mumbai Salt City for Rotary Year 2026–27.
